locations.note: The festival's hub on the Côte d'Azur: Nice's seafront and old town, where the game opens and the championships are announced.
Sisteron, scaled down with its citadel rock above the Durance, one of the map's two French towns.
Lavender fields, vineyards and hill roads of Provence make up the inland half of the map.
Saint-Martin-du-Var, the other scaled-down French town, on the Var valley road.
Drivers race through Castelletto, an invented town modelled on Amalfi, and the coast's cliff roads around it.
The coast road along the Riviera, the game's main artery between the French towns.
The Italian end of the map: Ligurian coast roads and hill villages over the border.
